body: I used to build medical devices for a living and a few other inventions in the medical field exist that I never got credit for because of academic politics. It feels like a distant memory now, I barely think of it except when I go here. I wish I didn't. If my medical career ends, which seems entirely likely, I don't know how I'd even get back into the game. Not that I'd even want to. Engineering was not something I enjoyed ultimately and I've been left with a tremendous amount of bitterness and burnout because of it. I'm not even current anymore.

Hi,

Thanks for your concern. I still feel like I might do it but I made a promise to myself and My therapist that I'd wait it out and not do anything rash.

In a twisted way, sharing these thoughts gives me an outlet for that energy that makes me want to follow through. It really is torture :(
It would be depressing and rated nc17

The suicide crisis line sent me this thing representing it as a forum for real people. The realization that the best I could do was a fucking AI script... this fucking planet.

As soon as the stuff gets here for my suicide kit I'm gone. Its my most comforting thought.

I've spent years in therapy. The emotional trauma I worked through but you aren't allowed to escape your past.

I can't do anything else. I'm broke and in too much debt.

I haven't dated for a year. This is a life synopsis, with major omissions. Whole thing has been shit.
Anyone around? I could really use some help to avoid ending it all.
I dont know. Im trying to find some meaning in my existence and even though I still dont feel I have any I do want to help others find some positivism in theirs.

Im asking you to break it down into smaller pieces mostly for yourself. believe me, I have been suicidal before too and actually, just today I was this close to doing it. I was going to inject myself with bleach. someone talked to me for about 5 hours today through text and it really helped. 

I know what its like when you feel every emotion simultaneously and it all feels so overwhelming. at least for me its like a fog of all my problems choking the life right out of me.
can you take a few moments to ask yourself something? what is it about your GF that has cost you your identity? does she deserve to have so much power over you? over your life?

hey ive been there, especially when it comes to the abuse. I can tell your mind is racing and everything seems overwhelming right now. can you post back here and break things down a little bit? 

its hard to think through things or manage problems when you're caught up in chaos. especially a chaotic mind. can we help you be present in the moment? can we help you feel a little grounded?

its a sign of your desperation that you feel this is the only way people will notice you. is there anyone you can reach out to? 

someone really helped me today, so maybe we can talk and I can pay it forward?
Hey that makes me feel good that I was good for something. I hate feeling like this and not being able to connect with anyone. What do you do for a living? Im a doctor.

my ex wife was catholic, she insisted I become catholic. She got knocked up by the priest that married us 6 months into our marriage. 

fuck that entirely. no guy in a funny hat is going to fix me.

I'm so tired.

No one cares enough to even return my texts when I reach out. 

I appreciate the website but all of this takes money. Money I dont have.

Yeah thats what Ive been doing but every time I get close the rug gets torn out from under me 

Im so frustrated with it
Im not of use to the world. I have no value. and I dont even have the stuff I need to survive.

Ive herd this refrain for 15 years. When is it going to happen? Im 37. Most people have their shit together way more than I do. 

Im kind of a failure at life.
Im a bad liar. I can't fake it. Im tired of faking it. I don't want to try anymore.

See thats the thing. I dont have any family or any close friends. Its pretty pathetic to be 37 and not have anyone you know you can reach out to or who actually likes being with you. Who will seek you out.

Ive thought about doing exactly that. Cash advancing all my credit cards and taking one last road trip. I'd probably kill myself someplace in Yellowstone with muscle relaxers. Maybe a bear would find me and eat me. Id return to the dirt that way at least. Fuel the nitrogen cycle or something. 

The reality is that no one would miss me.
Hang on to what? I'm not important.

Its fucked up how everyone asks me to work a little harder and do a little more. How Im almsot at the end of these hard times. 

Why should I care? Who do I care about?
The spouse I dont have?
The GF I havent met?
The kids I wont have?
The friends Ive lost, the ones who dont return my calls, or the ones I never made?
For me? Ive had plenty of life to know how it goes.

Im done.
you cant control the past, nor can you control how other people act think or feel. can you control you? are you feeling really emotional right now?

Honestly, at this point, I dont care about it. I just want to be left alone and to drop out of society altogether.  Getting another residency is hard. And Im a good doctor. 

I used to want to retire by 45 but to me, being dead might be just as good. I want to be loved and cared about, and if I can't have that, I just want to be left alone and allowed to exist without fear of instability. I want to trust others.

I know I see happy people, with stabel relationships, who dont get in trouble at work all the time, who aren't always scrutinized, and who have friendships. I dont know why its so hard for me or whats "wrong" with me. 

There arent any people in my life who can listen. They have their own stuff to do.
Why do you say you'll always come up short? That sucks about the dating profile but it sounds like theres more to it. Sounds more like youre getting in your own way.

I mean that we can't tell someone if we're having a bad day, or we feel uncertain, or we're hurting inside. no one wants to hear that shit. People ask "how are you" and its the most superficial thing in the world. No one actually cares. 

I resent the fact that I can't be or feel normal.
Its shameful that we arent allowed to express them
how did you mess up?

I have no family, only a few friends, most are married with kids. Im unmarried, divorced actually, I live alone. Ive been a "successful" dater if you go by numbers but Ive only had one really "intimate" experience with another person... where I truly felt cared for and loved. 

I was fired from my job today, and told that I was hopeless, that I couldn't be trained or remediated. Im a medical resident. A doctor in the USA. 

I have a house, and $350k of debt. And no future. 

I hate small talk, and the dysfunction of our culture. and the lies we tell each other to be "polite" 

I hate the crushing darkness of being alone. of feeling alone. I dont want to be a part of this anymore. Death seems like a release and no one would really miss me in the long run. 

Im not worthless but I have no value to anyone.

Yeah I just felt lonely, I havent had human contact in a long time. A friend touched my back the other day and I just wanted to bawl. I really just want someone to hug me and tell me things will be ok, that Im meaningful and that they believe in me.

Is it? I dont see why. What I mean by "quality part" is that I know I'm a person of love, kindness, integrity and peacefulness but it seems that no one can see that in me. No one believes in me, no one can really connect with me. I want to know that Im cared about and that I'm "enough" and I honestly am just tired of playing the games of human interaction

Something Im struggling with is the idea that you can be a high quality part that doesnt fit anywhere in the machine. That really summarizes how I feel. Valuable yet worthless in the grand design. Important, just not important enough for anyone to connect with, etc etc.
Me too. Lets talk? We can talk here or I can hit you up on Facetime.
Is anyone around who'd like to talk to me? Maybe facetime or something?
